name: magpie-select-translate
description: 划词翻译：选中文字按热键（默认 Alt+D），鼠标旁浮窗流式显示 magpie 模型的译文。Select-to-translate popover for magpie, with a bundled Windows helper.

summary.en: Select text anywhere and press a hotkey: a popover next to the cursor streams the translation from magpie's own models. Ships the Windows helper, so there is nothing else to install.
summary.zh: 在任意程序里选中文字按热键，鼠标旁的浮窗流式显示 magpie 模型的译文。包内自带 Windows helper，装上就能用。
